summary: For mammals, PanTHERIA holds density, litter size, litters per year and body mass for thousands of species in one open table, and TetraDENSITY adds locality-level density for tetrapods to join on species. Juvenile mortality is the missing variable (matrix databases hold survival but not field abundance), and non-mammal species lack fecundity+density in one place.
next_step: Join PanTHERIA with COMADRE-derived early survival for mammals (registration needed) or restrict to the mammal slice; pre-register fecundity-excluding-mortality model.
obstacles_confirmed: Absolute abundance missing for many species with fecundity data
Body size confounds both fecundity and density
